about: Hand corrections applied when the dataset is built. Every entry carries its reason.
countingRule: A goal counts when the organiser of the competition credits it to him in an official senior match: league, cup and continental games for his clubs, and full internationals for Portugal, friendlies included. Club friendlies, exhibition trophies, youth and B-team games and penalty shoot-out kicks do not count.
countDisputedNote: One goal is credited differently by different bodies (23 October 2026, Al-Faisaly v Al-Nassr). With this switch on the total follows the Saudi Pro League and the headline count used by ESPN's tracker and most outlets; with it off the total follows Opta and the other data providers and is one lower.
celebrationNote: 'auto' lets the goal-1,000 celebration play once the count reaches 1,000. 'hold' keeps it from playing whatever the count says, for the moments when the count needs a human look first. Set it with the Match-night controls workflow.

neutral._note: true = played on neutral ground although the fixture lists a home side; false = not neutral although the general rule says so.

venueByEvent._note: Matches for which the feed names no stadium. Internationals follow Wikipedia's list of his international goals; the three club games were ordinary home fixtures.

neutralReasons.363330: 2013 Copa del Rey final v Atlético Madrid was staged at the Santiago Bernabéu, his own home ground.
neutralReasons.734870: 2025 AFC Champions League Elite quarter-final v Yokohama F. Marinos: the finals stage was held centrally in Jeddah.
